The unmodified source contains 55 meshes, two armatures, a 52-bone worker
armature and a 47,900-triangle production ant assembled from individually
rigged anatomical segments. It also includes a large set of author animations.
Its ant material is procedural and does not contain a redistributable
photographic texture; Canopy Kin therefore uses its own cuticle PBR set.

Project modifications are described in
`Assets/Resources/Models/Ant/Family/SOURCE.md`. The original `.blend` is
retained unmodified for provenance and future re-export.
